The declared function type only narrows which loop-called bindings are ATTEMPTED for entry resolution; it licenses no call. The resolution itself goes through js_closure_resolve_arrow_direct_call(handle, arity), which validates the value is an arrow closure of that arity at runtime, so a wrong or stale declared type yields a failed resolution and the ordinary dynamic call, never a wrong callee. Async and generator function types are excluded at this read.
This iteration derives the typed-ABI metadata oracle while filtering globals; typed entry paths independently guard live argument and capture values.
